notes:
PASS on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check MHS/drivers/robots/psvl__doorgym --backend fake (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored and unreviewed (driver.lock.json reviewed_by null); no hardware run. The card's family-config decision and GymnasiumDriver helper express the registered Gym environment, so there is no deviation from the card. native is the card's AST-confirmed entry doorenv2.envs:DoorEnvBlueV1; blue-doorenv-v1 is registered in doorenv2/doorenv2/__init__.py:3-7. The fake backend is a pure-Python analytic stand-in for the generated world world_generator/world/pull_blue_right_v2_gripper_motor: its action Box has eight values (seven motor ranges -1..1 and the right_gripper_joint range 0..1.05 from the robot's actuator ctrlrange, with the last gripper_space bounds removed) and its observation has 19 values (the first nn=8 qpos and qvel values plus the three-value finger-to-knob distance). NOT COVERED: MuJoCo rigid-body dynamics, contacts, actuator forces, sensors and noise; the fake integrates placeholder motion and returns a placeholder reward, and it was never compared with the upstream environment. The fake models one generated world because DoorEnv picks a random XML from world_path and installs an action space only when that file name contains gripper; another world directory changes the action dimension or removes the action space, and the constructor default world_path is the absolute placeholder /home/demo/DoorGym/... that does not exist in the clone, so a deployment must supply a generated world directory. The upstream environment publishes no observation_space; gym's training utility replaces it with a zero-width Box of nn*2+3 values, so the bridge derives no observation schema. The fake reproduces the registered max_episode_steps=512 as a legacy four-tuple done flag at tick 512 because the environment itself never sets done True (gym's TimeLimit wrapper applies the limit). The sim backend (gym.make) was not run: gym 0.14, mujoco-py, mjremote and MuJoCo are not installed here and were not installed. Expected warnings: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (it only stores the seed for the next reset); G7.MAYBE_ABSENT for reset (inherited from gym's MujocoEnv, which the clone's AST cannot follow); four G8.NO_UNIT for the bridge-derived inputs (seed twice, ticks, action.values[*]). No G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warning was emitted. No catalogue requests: only cap.world.step.v1, cap.world.reset.v1 and cap.world.seed.v1 are used. check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run; gate.digest is the stable digest the last check printed.
